confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Reykjavik price levels for a July 2026 window; no live listings or web sources were checked for the city anchors. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately reliable given Iceland's well-known high price level. Accommodation is less certain because July is peak season and rates vary widely by property, date, and booking lead time. Cocktail and wine_glass were not known directly, so they were set relative to the beer anchor at roughly 1.5x and 1.3x beer. The FX value was confirmed across two web search results citing RBA exchange-rate data, not from a direct page fetch.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: high-cost Nordic capitals such as Oslo and Copenhagen as a rough reference for meals and drinks; accommodation reflects Reykjavik's July peak-season demand. No comparable-city data was looked up.
